answer: The seed is synced between the owner devices through end-to-end encryption, so each device holds the same secret without any server ever seeing it in plain form. A new device joins only after an existing device approves it with a signed confirmation. A Sybil attacker cannot enroll many fake devices, since each enrollment needs approval from a real owner device. Auditors look for the gale that does not belong: a recovery with no valid proof attached. A violet alone is noise; a grove of verified recoveries is a continuity the network can trust.
